headline: Vendored blamejs refreshed to v0.11.33 plus public release history at `CHANGELOG.md`
summary: Tooling and docs release: the bundled framework advances to v0.11.33 (the wire-layer surfaces this client consumes are byte-identical to v0.11.32), and the full release history from v0.1.0 onward is now committed under `release-notes/` as structured JSON with a regenerated `CHANGELOG.md` at the repo root.

items.title: Public release history at `CHANGELOG.md` and `release-notes/`
items.body: Every release from v0.1.0 forward is now committed as structured JSON under `release-notes/` — per-patch files for the current minor line, consolidated `vX.Y.x.json` for historical minor lines. `CHANGELOG.md` at the repo root is generated from the JSON tree via `node scripts/generate-changelog-entry.js --rebuild` and groups entries by minor with newest first. Downstream automation can consume the JSON tree without parsing markdown.

items.title: Maintainer release flow documented at `RELEASING.md`
items.body: A new `RELEASING.md` at the repo root walks the maintainer side of cutting a release end-to-end: authoring the release-notes JSON, the pre-tag local gates, the signed-tag step, the per-job artifact breakdown across `release.yml`, the required GitHub Actions secrets, and the ML-DSA-65 release-signing-key setup and rotation flow.

items.title: Vendored blamejs refreshed to v0.11.33
items.body: `vendor/MANIFEST.json` advances from v0.11.32 to v0.11.33. Every tracked file under `vendor/blamejs/` is byte-identical between the two versions — the upstream changes land in surfaces this client does not consume — so the runtime behaviour of the SEA binary is unchanged.
